text:
Andrew Mangiapane has played ten games for the Blackhawks, his fourth NHL team, and he hasn't scored yet. He's in a depth role, about 11 minutes a night, with two assists.

The interesting part is how Chicago plays with him on. At five on five the Blackhawks take 58% of the expected goals in his minutes, 17 points better than when he sits. That's the best relative number on a team that has struggled to control games, even if it comes in a small sample.

The goals should come: 1.2 expected and nothing yet. This is a player who scored 35 goals for Calgary in 2021-22, so finishing hasn't always been his problem. At 30, NHL Edge has his top speed near the bottom of the league.

Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him exiting the zone with possession 69% of the time last season, a quiet skill. What to watch: whether the strong on-ice numbers get him promoted, especially with Connor Bedard out.
